claims.text: The span detector is part of an extended Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) that includes a binary classifier for unanswerable questions.
The architecture employs a shared lower layer for both the span detector and the binary classifier, with separate top layers for each task.
The span detector utilizes a multi-task learning approach, optimizing jointly with the unanswerable classifier.
The SAN answer module is specifically employed for the span detection task.
